summary: Comprehensive testing of T'aksi ride-hailing application with focus on multi-language support, authentication flows, and map improvements. Backend APIs functioning well, frontend loading correctly with excellent language switching capabilities.

integration_issues.issue: Occasional page revert to homepage during flow navigation

passed_tests: Landing page loads correctly with T'aksi branding
Multi-language selector supports 12 languages (Georgian, English, Russian, Hindi, Chinese, Nederlands, French, German, Polish, Afrikaans, isiZulu, isiXhosa)
Language switching works smoothly with immediate UI translation
Backend health endpoint responds correctly (200 OK)
Rider registration API functional with JWT token generation
Firebase connection established and user data persistence working
Rider portal accessible via 'Book a Ride' button
Driver portal accessible via 'Become a Pilot' button
Vehicle selection interface displays properly with pricing
Phone-based authentication UI present in both portals
Modern dark theme UI with proper contrast and spacing
